## What this slice does

One or two sentences.

## Spec and plan

- Spec: docs/features/<feature-name>/spec.md
- Spec items covered by this slice:
- Risk level: low / high (high = touches authentication, money, personal data or permissions)

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests for this slice were written from the spec and committed before the implementation
- [ ] CI gate is green on the final commit
- [ ] No new dependency, or each new dependency was approved in the plan
- [ ] No secrets, keys or credentials in the diff

## Human review

- [ ] Part 1 of docs/templates/review-checklist.md completed
- [ ] Part 2 completed (required for high risk)
- [ ] Review note saved in the feature folder

## If something failed or surprised you

- [ ] Failure log entry added to docs/failure-log.md, with its stage of origin
